title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to change Zero (0) of Flowfield field to Dash (-) on the page
summary: FlowField values can display a dash instead of zero using the BlankZero property on page fields, which works for both standard and custom fields but not editable fields.
key_points: FlowFields calculate and display results based on CalcFormula, such as inventory sums from ledger entries
The BlankZero property set to true hides zero values and displays them as blank or dash on pages
This formatting approach applies to custom fields and methods returning numbers, but does not work for editable fields
AutoFormatExpression and AutoFormatType properties control the underlying zero format behavior

quotes.text: FlowFields display the result of the calculation described in the CalcFormula Property.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core purpose of FlowFields in calculating and displaying derived values from base tables
Provides the simple solution for replacing zero display with dash or blank on pages

quotes.text: This does not work for editable fields.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important limitation that prevents users from applying this approach to all field types
